description:
False killer whales are dolphins that hunt like orcas: they harass sperm whales, pin three-meter swordfish and share every big catch with the pod. And sometimes they offer that catch to people. Doug follows one from a kilometer away to zero, ending at Kona, Hawaii, in 1984, when a false killer whale swam up to a researcher in the water and let go of a tuna.

Which animal should Doug get too close to next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe and watch Doug's death counter keep climbing.
